items.title: STeP-TS: Shared Temporal Filters with Pruning for Time Series
items.summary: From the abstract: We propose a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns a shared bank of multi-scale temporal filters of each variable.

items.title: TimeWorld: Towards Action-Conditioned Multimodal World Models for Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To investigate these gaps, we introduce TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for multimodal TSWMs spanning seven real-world datasets, with textual interventions grounded in recorded action--outcome data. Our evaluation reveals that conventional multimodal forecasters underperform history-only time series foundation models (TSFMs) despite dataset-specific training, whereas simple text-prefix adaptations improve forecasting across all evaluated TSFM backbones.

items.title: VRATF: Vision-based Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To address this limitation, this paper proposes VRATF, a vision-based retrieval-augmented time series forecasting framework. VRATF first extracts low-frequency trend components from historical sequences using frequency-domain filtering, renders the denoised trends as line-chart images, and encodes them with a frozen vision encoder to construct a visual retrieval database.

items.title: Dynamic Multi-Step Decoding for Time-Series Foundation Models
items.summary: From the abstract: We argue that the optimal decoding strategy is not fixed across inputs, but should be selected adaptively for each forecasting instance. We propose a dynamic strategy selector that treats the forecast rollout schedule as an inference-time decision problem for frozen pretrained time-series foundation models.

items.title: MetaARIMA: Configuration-Level Transfer Learning for ARIMA Models
items.summary: From the abstract: We propose MetaARIMA, a pretrained configuration policy based on metalearning that brings transfer learning to classical statistical forecasting at the configuration level rather than the model level. The policy learns from historical experiments which ARIMA configurations achieve top-quantile performance, and recommends promising candidates for new series while preserving interpretability and local estimation.

items.title: How Much Graph Is Too Much? Graph Construction and Exposure in Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We study these choices as graph construction and graph exposure on U.S. state unemployment, traffic speed, and electricity demand. … Late integration alone is insufficient, while adding a fusion gate yields lower mean error in all three tasks.

items.title: PMU Foundation Model Bridge: A Tool for Connecting Synchrophasor Streams to Time Series Foundation Models
items.summary: From the abstract: This paper presents PMU Foundation Model Bridge, an open source tool that connects online phasor measurement unit (PMU) or phasor data concentrator (PDC) streams to publicly available time series foundation models (TSFM). … In the initial release, 4 publicly available TSFMs were supported, including Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Timestral, and TimesFM-3.

items.title: Learning What to Share: Expert Specialization for Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: These insights motivate Persistent Closed-Form Routing (PCR), a plug-and-play method that alternates exact conditional estimation of channel-specific mixture weights with gradient-based training of low-rank residual experts around a frozen pretrained forecaster. Averaged over four forecasting horizons, PCR-K4 achieves dataset-balanced mean squared error reductions of 3.86-14.25% relative to the three frozen backbones.

items.title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
items.summary: From the abstract: We model the cumulative carbon cost of different approaches across a realistic industrial scenario: Chronos-2 amortizes its pretraining cost within months for large or frequently queried deployments, but a classical model remains cheaper indefinitely for small or rarely queried ones.

items.title: When to Trust Memory: Retrieval-Guided Probabilistic Spatiotemporal Forecasting under Distribution Shift
items.summary: From the abstract: To address this issue, we propose REMIND, a retrieval-guided probabilistic framework for spatiotemporal forecasting under distribution shift.

items.title: DBCM: Dual-Branch Calibration Module for Test-Time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: Motivated by this observation, we propose the Dual-Branch Calibration Module (DBCM), which shares adaptation capacity across channels through a shared adapter while retaining limited channel-specific flexibility through a low-rank channel-wise adapter, further enhanced by channel mixing and nonlinear gated modulation.

items.title: TempShap: When and How Much a Feature Matters in Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We propose TempShap, a retrospective, loss-based Shapley framework whose players are the individual input cells $(t,i)$. Its attribution tensor yields temporal-localization and horizon-impact profiles.

items.title: Model-agnostic predictability quantification of multivariable time series
items.summary: From the abstract: In this work, we propose Multivariable Predictability Score (MAPS), a model-agnostic metric for measuring the intrinsic predictability of multivariable time series forecasting tasks.

items.title: Volatility-Corrected Prediction Intervals: Locally Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We then propose Volatility-Corrected Prediction Intervals (VCPI), a post-hoc calibration procedure that uses the base forecaster's predictive scale as a baseline, models the volatility of standardized forecast residuals with a Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) model, and applies a multiplicative correction to produce locally adaptive prediction intervals.

items.title: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
items.summary: From the abstract: We propose Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost (DISC), a learnable aggregation framework that uses calibration transfer observations to select, weight, and combine similarity metrics for different downstream tasks.

items.title: Zero-Shot Forecasting of In-Situ Soil Moisture and Temperature with a Time-Series Foundation Model
items.summary: From the abstract: We evaluate TimesFM 1, a 500M-parameter time-series foundation model, zero-shot on 15-minute telemetry from 27 sensor stations across three land-management regimes (Control, Treatment, Scald) at a semi-arid restoration site, forecasting 5 cm and 30 cm soil moisture and enclosure temperature at seven lead times from 1 h to 168 h.

items.title: GateFormer: Forecast-Space Decomposition for Intra-Hour Solar Irradiance Prediction from Sky Images
items.summary: From the abstract: To address this, we introduce GateFormer, a GHI-conditioned dual-decoder ViT for intra-hour global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasting through forecast-space decomposition.

items.title: Is spectral predictability enough? Testing Ω-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift
items.summary: From the abstract: We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds.

items.title: TimeH2O v1 (Hugging Face model page)
items.summary: From the model card: Time series foundation model by H2O.ai. Datasets overlapping with fev-bench, GIFT-Eval, and TIME were excluded from training.

items.title: A Model-Agnostic Correction Framework for Short-Term Building Load Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: Motivated by this idea, we propose WeL-RAC, a model-agnostic Weather-Load Retrieval-Augmented Correction framework that explicitly retrieves such evidence at prediction time. The framework improves the corresponding base forecasters in 90 of 96 dataset-level comparisons.

items.title: Forecasting Associations, Not Interventions: A Preregistered Causal Audit of Covariate-Aware Time Series Foundation Models
items.summary: From the abstract: Covariate-aware time series foundation models (TSFMs) accept a future path for a control variable and return a forecast, inviting what-if queries. The query is interventional; the models are trained on observational data.

items.title: Local and Global Recursive Ridge Regression for Online Residual Correction of Frozen Multivariate Forecasters under Label Delay
items.summary: From the abstract: Aiming to combine a small retained state with a large error reduction, we propose DRiC (DCT Ridge Corrector), which fits a ridge regression of the leading discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients of the next residual block on those of the frozen forecast and of the latest input block, with sufficient statistics updated recursively.

items.title: Rethinking Agentic Model Orchestration for Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To disentangle these effects, we introduce FairAMO, a controlled evaluation protocol with frozen candidate forecasts. Experiments on GIFT-Eval show that AMO improves accuracy, but its gains are bounded by the candidate TSFMs.

items.title: Probabilistic Machine Learning for Short-Term Atmospheric Seeing Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: In this work, we benchmark machine learning models for predicting atmospheric seeing up to two hours in advance, with a particular focus on probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification.

items.title: Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective
items.summary: From the abstract: To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data.

items.title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization.

items.title: Asymmetric Bidirectional Predictive Dynamics in Google Search and COVID-19 Time Series: A Multi-Horizon Forecast-Error Analysis
items.summary: From the abstract: We examine eight pre-specified Google Trends-COVID-19 pairs in both directions using matched LightGBM forecasts over rolling 400-day windows and horizons of 1-14 days.

items.title: Model- and Layer-Level Closed-Loop Forecasting with SSM-Based Spiking Neural Networks
items.summary: From the abstract: We explore two closed-loop forecasting strategies, in which the network's own generated values are fed back into the network as if they were observed past values: (i) model-level and (ii) layer-level closed-loop forecasting.

items.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models for Electrical Load Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels.

items.title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data.

items.title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
items.summary: From the abstract: We argue that continual prompt evolution is a practical, training-free alternative to retraining for multimodal forecasting.

items.title: Dynamic Dual-Feedback Conformal Inference for Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: In this paper, we propose Dynamic Dual-feedback Conformal Inference (DDCI), which incorporates a dual-feedback mechanism consisting of actual feedback and estimated feedback.

items.title: WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: WhatIf-Bench: benchmark for intervention-aware time-series forecasting with covariates.

items.title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models
items.summary: Capability-focused evaluation of time-series foundation models with structural diversity.

items.title: CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries
items.summary: Abstract opening: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations.

items.title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture.

items.title: Paloma: Phase-Conditioned Residual Modulation for Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: Abstract opening: Explicitly modeling periodicity has proven to be an efficient approach for time series forecasting, where the residual, obtained after removing the periodic component from the time series, is typically treated as unstructured noise.

items.title: CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction
items.summary: From the abstract: In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables.

items.title: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
items.summary: From the abstract: We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator.

items.title: Multi-site Learning for Forecasting Day-Ahead Wind-Power Production for Onshore Wind Farms in Great Britain with Deep Neural Networks
items.summary: From the abstract: In this study, we train multi-site deep neural networks (DNNs) using pooled historical production and reanalysis weather data from 88 onshore wind Balancing Mechanism Units (BMUs).

items.title: Data-driven forecasting of tropical cloud forest phenology: A dynamical systems and machine learning hybrid approach
items.summary: From the abstract: While traditional phenological models often rely on preconceived functional forms, this study introduces a data-driven hybrid approach that integrates dynamical systems theory with machine learning to forecast flowering and fruiting cycles.

items.title: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets
items.summary: From the abstract: This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. The answer changed with the grain.

items.title: Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors.

items.title: Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off
items.summary: From the abstract: Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions.

items.title: Learning volatility-adaptive forgetting via GARCH-modulated LSTM for stock price forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: This paper presents the Gsigmoid-LSTM model, which embeds Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroscedasticity (GARCH(1,1))-derived volatility estimates into the LSTM forgetting gate through the Gsigmoid activation function, a volatility-adaptive variant of the sigmoid that combines a volatility adjustment factor with slope regulation via a learnable parameter.

items.title: A decomposition-integration framework coupling singular spectrum analysis with a volatility-adaptive LSTM for stock price forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: To address these gaps, this paper proposes CEEMDAN-SE-SSA-VMGL. On five US and Chinese financial series (CSI 300, CSI 500, AAPL, GOOGL, S&P 500), the proposed model is compared with eleven benchmark architectures, lowering the forecasting error by 9% to 24% relative to the best benchmark and by 60% to 70% relative to a standard LSTM.

items.title: Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention
items.summary: Morpheus-2.0: universal probabilistic forecaster with dual-axis attention.

items.title: Forecasting Voltage Time Series under Anomalies Using a WGAN Model With Lipschitz Control and Progressive Kernel Critic Strategy
items.summary: Abstract opening: In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process.

items.title: LagNet: Lag-Structured Operators for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: Abstract opening: Long-term time series forecasting maps a finite history window to an extended future horizon.

items.title: Timestral: Mistral's time-series foundation models
items.summary: Mistral AI introduces Timestral, its first family of time-series foundation models.

items.title: DST-Net: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal Network for Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: Abstract opening: Series decomposition has emerged as a widely acknowledged paradigm in deep time series forecasting models.

items.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
items.summary: Abstract opening: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting.

items.title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss.

items.title: Choosing models for network-wide freeway speed estimation and forecasting from sparse fixed sensors
items.summary: From the abstract: This paper compares methods for estimating current and next-hour speeds on every link from such sparse detectors, using historical probe data for training.

items.title: CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction
items.summary: From the abstract: In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series.

items.title: Learning to Forecast on Multiple Spatiotemporal Hierarchies
items.summary: From the abstract: In this work, we propose a graph deep learning framework that leverages variations across hierarchies as multi-task regularization. We show that jointly learning across these structures can reduce over-specialization to any single hierarchy and improve forecasting performance.

items.title: Learning and Forecasting Multiscale Spatiotemporal Epidemic Dynamics with Lagrangian-Eulerian Graph Neural ODEs
items.summary: From the abstract: We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation.

items.title: ChronoSheaf: Joint Spatio-Temporal Spectral Filtering on Cellular Sheaves
items.summary: From the abstract: Building on this operator, we introduce ChronoSheaf, a spatio-temporal sheaf network with two key components. … We validate ChronoSheaf on a diverse set of spatio-temporal forecasting benchmarks, where it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

items.title: Single-stage joint diffusion of sky images and clear-sky index for ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting: what the frame-to-irradiance stage discards
items.summary: From the abstract: We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state.

items.title: Timestral-209M (Hugging Face model page)
items.summary: Mistral AI's 209M-parameter Timestral time-series forecasting model on Hugging Face.

items.title: Timestral 5M / 28M / 123M checkpoints (Hugging Face)
items.summary: Mistral AI published smaller Timestral checkpoints (5M, 28M, 123M) alongside Timestral-209M.

items.title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction
items.summary: Abstract opening: Foundation models for dynamical systems can forecast unseen partial differential equations (PDEs), ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and time series during inference.

items.title: Beyond Static Positional Encoding: Bayesian Time-aware Attention for Non-Stationary Long-term Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: Abstract opening: Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging.

items.title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
items.summary: Abstract opening: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real-world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs.

items.title: CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: Abstract opening: Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging.

items.title: Quantile-Guided Diffusion for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: From the abstract: We instantiate this approach as Control-TS, which learns a quantile-control pathway while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Across eight benchmarks, Control-TS consistently improves the backbone's CRPS, achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art forecasting models, and retains its gains in capacity-matched comparisons.

items.title: VaryST: Generalizable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Beyond the Closed-World Setting
items.summary: From the abstract: To this end, we propose VaryST, a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations. … Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets against seventeen baselines show that VaryST achieves strong in-domain forecasting accuracy, substantially improves zero- and few-shot generalization under spatial and temporal changes, and remains robust to varying observation availability.

items.title: Ranked Right, Sized Wrong: Ensemble Spread Fails Silently at Streamflow Extremes
items.summary: From the abstract: Deep learning models, particularly Long Short-Term Memory networks, are increasingly used for operational streamflow forecasting, with ensemble spread providing a signal of predictive uncertainty. As climate change increases the frequency of hydroclimatic extremes, these models will increasingly operate under flow conditions that are rare in their historical records. We therefore evaluate whether ensemble spread remains informative under increasing flows, examining both its magnitude relative to error and its ability to rank errors.

items.title: GIFT-Eval-CTX: A Benchmark For Contextual Forecasting Model Evaluation
items.summary: GIFT-Eval-CTX: benchmark for contextual forecasting that uses verified forward-looking information.

items.summary: Abstract opening: Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for many time series forecasting applications, and recent studies have increasingly adopted generative models to capture predictive uncertainty.

items.summary: From the abstract: We introduce a Physics-Informed Graph Neural Network (PING) for forecasting future advection-diffusion particle concentrations on irregular grids.

items.summary: From the abstract: We propose a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model for one-day-ahead integrated-variance forecasting.

items.summary: Abstract opening: Multiscale structure is central to time series forecasting: temporal signals contain slowly varying trends, intermediate seasonal patterns, and high-frequency residuals.

items.summary: Timer-M1: pretrained multivariate time-series foundation model for zero-shot forecasting.

items.summary: Abstract opening: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas.

items.summary: Abstract opening: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) models predominantly employ patch-based encoders terminated by a flatten readout head that maps the entire encoded historical memory to all future steps through a single shared projection.

items.summary: Abstract opening: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features.
